bug_semantics: On Azure DevOps, Renovate authenticates git clone/ls-remote with `git -c http.extraheader=AUTHORIZATION: <basic|bearer> <authValue>` from getStorageExtraCloneOpts. The extraheader is concatenated into git argv and then appears in Renovate logs when simple-git errors (and similar command dumps) are serialized through the logger. host-rules already registered the raw token and username:password base64 with util/sanitize, but a 52-character Azure PAT is sent as `basic` plus base64(`:`+token), which is a different secret string and was never added. Anyone who can read those server or pipeline logs can recover the bot credential.
flaw_origin: PR #5602 first introduced Azure extraheader git auth in getStorageExtraCloneOpts without calling sanitize.add on the extraheader auth material. That is the first write of the CWE-532 mechanism; later `--config`→`-c` and file moves only relocated the same construction.
